=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:137-145,691-694 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The preflight deny-list no longer contains failed/FAILED/error/skipped, and PREFLIGHT_PASSED_RE only needs "pass(ed):" plus one non-space character, so contradictory results such as "passed: FAILED, 2 callers remain" or "passed: skipped (network unavailable)" pass validation.
  WHY: validate_result accepts the result, check_diff approves the registry removal and script deletion, and run_apply pushes them with GH_PAT, which bypasses the hard preflight gate; severity disagreement: minimax, luna and glm rated it MAJOR (mapped to high), sonnet rated it NIT as a narrow defense-in-depth gap.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:137,693 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: PREFLIGHT_NOT_PASSED_RE.search scans the whole result string for cannot/can't/could not/unable to, so valid passing evidence such as "passed: grep found 0 callers, so the script cannot be reached from any workflow" is rejected.
  WHY: finish_audit calls _audit_fail(state, "result_invalid") and no marker is saved, so the up-to-75-minute PLAN_AUDIT re-runs on every idle */15 tick, which brings back the re-run loop the previous round removed.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:754-757 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: missing_plans treats a docs/completed/<name>.md classification as coverage for a live docs/plans/<name>.md even when that plan was not archived in this run, and integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md already exists under both paths.
  WHY: The model can leave out the live plan, finish_audit accepts the result, and decide_outcome reports idle_all_done and saves the marker, so the live plan is never audited; this defeats the new coverage check.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1261-1267 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When no prior answer window exists, the preserved answer's asked_at falls back to `now` (collected_at), which is later than the answer being preserved.
  WHY: On the next collect, trusted_answers drops the answer because it predates the new cutoff, comments=-1 forces a re-list on every run, and the decision issue never closes; test_preserved_answer_without_prior_window_uses_collect_time locks in this behavior.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:503-524,1218-1265 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: For a re-asked plan, asked_at is set to the collect time, but the new questions are PATCHed into the issue at decisions time, up to 75 minutes later, so an answer posted during the audit to the OLD questions is newer than the cutoff.
  WHY: The next collect accepts the late answer and pairs it with the new "## Questions" text through decision_questions, so an answer to the old Q1 can be applied to the replacement Q1 in the maintenance PR.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1243-1256 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: run_decisions reads an empty pr_number as "no file change", but run_apply also returns pr_number "" after pushing a branch when the pulls POST returns no number, and cmd_apply still exits 0.
  WHY: The decision issue is closed as completed with a "no file change" comment while the change sits on an ai/plan-autopilot-* branch with no PR, which contradicts Goal 7's PR link; all three rated it NIT (mapped to low).
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1267 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The decision issue is closed with a misleading "no file change" comment even when PR creation failed or returned an empty PR number after the maintenance branch was pushed.
  WHY: The applied fix stays isolated on a remote branch without review or merge visibility, which violates the requirement to link to the PR that applied the decision; rated MAJOR (mapped to high) and kept apart from the 1243-1256 entry because its line is more than 5 lines away.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:line 137 (PREFLIGHT_NOT_PASSED_RE) and line 693 in _semantic_errors (any(not PREFLIGHT_PASSED_RE.match(c["result"]) or PREFLIGHT_NOT_PASSED_RE.search(c["result"]) ...)) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The fail/error/skipped words were removed from the deny-list, so "passed: FAILED, 2 callers remain" or "passed: error, grep exited 2" passes, and the allow-list only needs "pass(ed):" plus one non-space character.
  WHY: validate_result accepts the result, and check_diff/run_apply delete the script and push the registry removal with GH_PAT; this is a narrow defense-in-depth gap.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:line 137, PREFLIGHT_NOT_PASSED_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:unrunnable|could ?not|couldn't|cannot|can't|unable to)\b", re.IGNORECASE), used with .search() at line 693 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The deny-list searches the whole result string, so real passing evidence such as "passed: ... the script cannot be reached from any workflow" is rejected.
  WHY: _audit_fail(state, "result_invalid") runs and save_marker=false, so the 75-minute PLAN_AUDIT re-runs every idle */15 tick; suggested fix: match the deny words only in the verdict prefix.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:lines 754-757, missing_plans | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A docs/completed/<name>.md entry counts as coverage for the live docs/plans/<name>.md whether or not it was archived, and integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md exists under both paths.
  WHY: The model can leave out the live plan, and the run is reported as idle_all_done with the marker saved; suggested fix: accept the completed path only when p is in {a["from"] for a in result["archived"]}.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:line 1267, known[path] = dict(known[path], comments=-1, asked_at=str(before.get("asked_at") or known[path].get("asked_at") or now)), with now = collected_at (line 1218) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When the earlier window is empty, the preserved answer's cutoff falls back to the collect time, which postdates the answer; the middle term is redundant.
  WHY: trusted_answers drops the answer for good, the issue never closes, and comments=-1 re-lists comments on every collect; tests/test_plan_autopilot.py::test_preserved_answer_without_prior_window_uses_collect_time locks in the bug; suggested fix: drop `or now`.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:line 1218 (now = collected_at), line 1229 (PATCH of the new question body during the decisions step), line 1233 ("asked_at": now), and line 1265 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A re-asked plan's asked_at is the collect time, set before an audit of up to 75 minutes, so an answer posted during the audit to the old questions is newer than asked_at.
  WHY: The late answer is paired with the new "## Questions" through decision_questions() and can be applied to a different Q1; suggested fix: set asked_at to _iso(_now()) at PATCH time.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:lines 1248-1253 in run_decisions (the no-PR branch) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: An empty pr_number is taken to mean no file change, but run_apply returns "" after a push when the pulls POST returns no number, and cmd_apply exits 0.
  WHY: The issue is closed as completed although the change sits on an ai/plan-autopilot-* branch with no PR, which contradicts Goal 7; suggested guard: check (state.get("apply") or {}).get("branch").
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Three items were deferred earlier with reasons that still stand (decision activity in the cache key, finishing the engine label on a later tick, the git-history baseline). tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py and tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py are failures inherited from the merge-base.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS covering line 137 / line 693, missing_plans lines 754-757, and line 1267; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3 (3 related items)
